newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 24.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 24.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Tuesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

A tropical depression has dissipated without affecting the coast. Other storms along central coastline causing light rains along coasts of Sinaloa, Nayarit, Jalisco, Colima, Michoacan, Guerrero and Oaxaca.
Clear skies and hot temperatures with maximum winds 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/16 to 22 miles per hour) and waves four to seven feet high.
Light to medium rains along coasts of Tamaulipas, Veracruz and Tabasco states. Maximum winds from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour).
Hot and partly cloudy with rains and regional winds about 10 to 15 knots. Waves three to five feet high.
Light rains along Nicaragua, Panama and Costa Rica.
